remarks: Why rent when you can own for less? This sunny, 2nd floor corner-unit offers a rare opportunity to build equity for less than the cost of rent-all in an unbeatable location just a short walk to vibrant downtown shops, restaurants, bars, and the train station. Inside you'll find a bright and airy one bed layout with a beautifully updated granite kitchen, custom tiled backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a stylishly updated bathroom. The corner location means tons of natural light throughout the day! Set in a well-maintained building with low common charges that include heat, hot water, water, sewer, trash, and an assigned covered off-street-parking spot-you get expectational value without the hidden costs. Additional large, clean, bright, common area laundry room adds even more connivence. Whether you're a first-time home buyer or looking to downsize smartly, this is an incredible opportunity to invest in yourself instead of throwing money away on rent. Truly a turnkey, move in ready unit not to be missed.
